title: Sprint G2 - packaging and install track
description: SPRINT BRIEF (app-level distribution track, moved from the global-manager epic to the distribution epic). Make bwrk a simple package install with composable scopes. Today the only installer is a dev shim (tools/install-local-bwrk.mjs) execing tsx against the source checkout - it requires the repo and pnpm install and cannot be distributed. Deliverables: a self-contained dist build with a real bin entry and install-channel detection; repo-scoped install mode with machine-binary delegation to the repo-pinned version; version-skew policy (dual-identity --version, doctor skew warnings, --no-delegate); install.sh implementing the default, --repo, and --machine flows with full flag overrides and idempotency; npm publish pipeline plus a Homebrew formula wrapping the npm tarball. The bwrk global first-run bootstrap is explicitly NOT here - it is addon behavior owned by the global-manager epic. Read the distribution epic brief before claiming any task.
acceptanceCriteria: All child tasks closed with passed verification evidence
